note: BNP Paribas's conditions and charges for the Principality of Monaco (1 January 2026), read again on 2026-10-30 for every international deferred-debit card it prices: the Visa Classic (49.50 euros a year), Visa Premier (144) and Visa Infinite (347), each a card whose month's spending is taken from the account at once, so nothing is carried. A card payment outside the euro zone costs 2.90% plus 0.90 euros (the Visa Infinite 2% plus 0.60): the share is written as the foreign fee, the fixed part not modelled. Withdrawals at the bank's own machines are free and those at other banks' machines outside the euro zone (2.90% plus 3 euros; Infinite 2% plus 2.20) aren't modelled as a cash fee. Discounts for a second card or for those 18 to 24, first-year offers, immediate-debit and BNP Net cards (debit) aren't written. The main banks: BNP Paribas, Société Générale (CFM Indosuez) and the Monaco banks; only BNP Paribas's Monaco tariffs were read on 2026-10-30. The earlier reading of the Visa Classic (2026-10-29) holds and is kept. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no bank was added. A search for Monaco banks' price lists found only BNP Paribas's; CFM Indosuez's site links no price list, and Société Générale Private Banking Monaco's answered with a near-empty page.
